title: Learning Dexterous Manipulation Using Contact Wrench Guidance From Human Demonstration
abstract: arXiv:2607.00033v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Dexterous robot manipulation can benefit from the abundance of human demonstrations, but transferring such demonstrations to robot policies remains challenging. We present Contact Wrench Guidance from Human Demonstration in Robotic Dexterous Manipulation (CHORD), a framework for long-horizon manipulation of rigid and articulated objects with reinforcement learning. The key idea is object-centric contact wrench space guidance: we represent human and robot motions by the forces and torques they can induce on the object, enabling similarity to be measured by the induced instantaneous motions. This guidance makes reinforcement learning more scalable for contact-rich dexterous manipulation. We further introduce a large-scale simulation benchmark with 4,739 bimanual dexterous manipulation tasks, constructed from motion-capture datasets and reconstructed in-house videos. translated_title: 利用人体演示中的接触力引导学习灵巧操作
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.00033v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：灵巧机器人操作可以从丰富的人体演示中受益，但将这些演示转化为机器人策略仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了CHORD（基于人体演示的机器人灵巧操作接触力引导）框架，这是一个用于刚性和铰接物体长时程操作的强化学习框架。核心思想是物体中心的接触力空间引导：我们通过人体和机器人能在物体上引起的力和力矩来表示其运动，从而通过引起的瞬时运动来度量相似性。这种引导使强化学习在接触丰富的灵巧操作中更具可扩展性。我们还引入了一个大规模仿真基准，包含4,739个双手灵巧操作任务，这些任务来自动作捕捉数据集和重建的内部视频。在1,831个基准任务上的评估中，CHORD实现了平均成功率（原文未完整）。
tldr: CHORD通过物体中心的接触力空间引导，将人体演示转化为机器人策略，显著提升了灵巧操作强化学习的可扩展性，并构建了大规模基准验证其有效性。
en_tdlr: CHORD leverages object-centric contact wrench space guidance to transfer human demonstrations into robot policies, enhancing scalability of reinforcement learning for dexterous manipulation, validated on a large-scale benchmark.
